name: Asks
description: Marks the lines that ask you something once a note settles, so Waiting on Evan lists them: Jev reads first, a bigger model confirms.

answer.description: The command that confirms what Jev passes: prompt on stdin, JSON of a yes or no per line on stdout; left out, Sonnet through claude

actions.label: Mark the lines that ask for a decision

args.name: dry
args.label: Dry run
args.description: yes: say what it would write, and write nothing

args.name: sure
args.label: Sure ones only
args.description: yes: leave the unsure lines unmarked, as a run over past notes does

actions.label: Take off the marks a tick, a reply or done answered
Take off the marks a comment answered

rules.description: Asks the write review about a note an agent wrote, a minute after it was last saved, and marks what it finds

match.query: NOT type=annotation NOT type=annotation-reply NOT type=peer-message NOT type=draft-proposal NOT type=snapshot NOT type=virtual-branch NOT type=jev-run NOT type=review-finding NOT machine NOT demo NOT from NOT ext.page NOT asks=off NOT type=permission-ask NOT type=proof NOT type=implementation-proof NOT type=validated NOT type=landed NOT type=merge NOT type=decision NOT type=build-log NOT type=log-entry NOT type=release-notes NOT type=artifact-run

rules.description: Takes a mark off when its line is ticked, you reply under it, or the note reaches done
Takes a mark off when you comment on its line, or on the whole note
